director.name: 朱塞佩·博尼图 Giuseppe Bonito

introduction: Pietro and Jacopo, his autistic son, are traveling to Puglia when their car breaks down. They are rescued by Oliviero, a local mechanic. Pietro and Jacopo find hospitality thanks to Agata, the owner of a bar that was once a guesthouse. Gaia, who works with Agata, forms a deep bond with Pietro. Life in the small town is slown and monotonous, a waiting for something until the resumption of the journey is ultimately prevented by the dramatic truth of the events.
